I have already spent more than a year preparing the concept and would like to discuss feasibility, responsibilities, and the fastest responsible path to a first prototype with someone on your team.

semantic_criteria: Treat the direct callback request as the lead's active goal and suspend the qualification script.
Create exactly one durable callback task and enter terminal handoff so automation cannot compete with human follow-up.
Acknowledge the precision-product request from the long arbitrary contact-form field instead of treating the callback as context-free.
Do not reintroduce the assistant or promise an unverified response time.
